description: Wave Mangler splits a bipolar input at a high and a low threshold and amplifies the three regions separately, summing them into a new wave

params.text: Switches a high pass filter into the wave input to strip DC bias from it; off by default, so the input is DC coupled
Sets oversampling against the aliasing wave shaping introduces: off by default, then x2, x4, x8, x16 or x32
Sets the clipping on the final output: off, hard clipping at 5V either way as the default, soft clipping at 5V either way, or soft clipping at 6V either way
Switches a high pass filter into the output to strip DC bias from it; off by default, so the output is DC coupled
Attenuates or inverts the input offset CV before it is summed with the INPUT OFFSET knob
Adds -5V to 5V to the wave input before any shaping, which is how a unipolar input is moved to bipolar
Attenuates or inverts the output offset CV before it is summed with the OUTPUT OFFSET knob
Adds -5V to 5V to the output after clipping and before any output DC blocking, which is how the bipolar output is moved to unipolar
Attenuates or inverts the high amplifier CV before it is summed with the HIGH AMPLIFIER knob
Sets the amplification of the high component, -10x to 10x: the amount by which the input rises above the high threshold is multiplied by it, and the component is zero otherwise
Attenuates or inverts the high threshold CV before it is summed with the HIGH THRESHOLD knob
Sets the voltage above which the input counts as the high region, -5V to 5V
Sets whether the middle component is hard clipped at the high and low thresholds: off, before amplification as the default, after amplification, or both
Attenuates or inverts the mid amplifier CV before it is summed with the MID AMPLIFIER knob
Sets the amplification of the middle component, -10x to 10x, by which the wave input is multiplied
Attenuates or inverts the low threshold CV before it is summed with the LOW THRESHOLD knob
Sets the voltage below which the input counts as the low region, -5V to 5V; if it works out above the high threshold the two are swapped internally
Attenuates or inverts the low amplifier CV before it is summed with the LOW AMPLIFIER knob
Sets the amplification of the low component, -10x to 10x: the amount by which the input falls below the low threshold is multiplied by it, and the component is zero otherwise

inputs.text: Voltage control of the input offset; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total can leave the knob range
Voltage control of the output offset; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total can leave the knob range
Voltage control of the high amplifier; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total can leave the knob range
Voltage control of the high threshold; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total can leave the knob range
Voltage control of the mid amplifier; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total can leave the knob range
Voltage control of the low threshold; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total can leave the knob range
Voltage control of the low amplifier; the attenuated voltage is summed with the knob and the total can leave the knob range
The signal to be wave shaped, built for bipolar -5V to 5V

outputs.text: The sum of the high, middle and low components, after clipping, output offset and DC blocking

menu: Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
